hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); base=${file##*/}; case "$base" in *.example|*.sample|*.template|*.dist|example.env|sample.env) exit 0;; esac; case "$base" in .env|.env.*|*.env) echo "Blocked: $base may contain secrets" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
filepath=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$filepath" in *.sh) command -v shfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 && shfmt -i 2 -w "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
